data.name: Aaghaa
data.gender_notes: Aaghaa is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A noble man, a commander, a leader, a chief, a ruler, an authority, a hero. The name Aaghaa carries the meaning “Leader, commander” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Aaghaa usually hope their child will grow to embody leader, commander and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A guardian of the faith, a protector, a warrior of Allah
data.etymology: Aaghaa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Leader, commander.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaghaa total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: أغا
in_arabic.meaning: أغا أصل اسم عسكري ثم أصبح لقبا عظيما
in_arabic.long_meaning: أغا أصل لفظ عسكري قديم، يعود إلى العصر العباسي، وتم استخدامه لقبا عظيما في العصر العثماني، ويعني الرفيع المكانة، والمحترم، والمرتفع الاجتماعي، ويستخدم في بعض البلدان العربية لوصف الشخص الرفيع المكانة، والمحترم، والذى له دور كبير فى المجتمع

in_urdu.name: اگھا
in_urdu.meaning: آغا ایک عسکری لفظ سے نکلا ہوا لقب ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: آغا ایک عسکری لفظ سے نکلا ہوا لقب ہے، جو کہ قدیم زمانے سے استعمال ہوتا رہا ہے، پھر اسے لقب کے طور پر استعمال کیا جاتا رہا، اور اس کے معنی ہیں رفيع مقام والا، محترم، اور آداب کا مالک، اور اس لقب کو بعض ممالک میں استعمال کیا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: आघा
in_hindi.meaning: आघा एक पुराना फौजदारी शब्द है जिसका उपयोग एक सम्मानजनक उपाधि के रूप में किया जाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: आघा एक पुराना फौजदारी शब्द है जिसका उपयोग एक सम्मानजनक उपाधि के रूप में किया जाता है, जिसका अर्थ है सम्मानित, उच्च स्तर के समाज, और सम्मान का पात्र, और यह उपाधि कुछ मुल्कों में उपयोग की जाती है

in_pashto.name: اګه
in_pashto.meaning: اګه د عسکري کلمې له څخه اخیستل شوی لقب دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: اګه د عسکري کلمې له څخه اخیستل شوی لقب دی، چې پخوا په تاریخ کې کارول کېده، او وروسته یې د لقب په توګه کارول کېده، او دا لقب به د لوړ مقام، محترمیت او ځانګړی شخصیت لرونکو ته ویل کېده، څوک چې د دې لقب په شان کاروي

in_english.name: Aaghaa
in_english.meaning: Aaghaa is a title of nobility and respect, derived from ancient military terminology
in_english.long_meaning: Aaghaa is a title of nobility and respect, derived from ancient military terminology, and has been used as a title of honor in various cultures and societies, particularly in the Ottoman Empire, and is associated with qualities such as high social status, respect, and prestige, and is often used to describe individuals of high social standing and authority

pronunciation.urdu: آغا کی تلفظ میں آغا کو دو آوازیں آئیں اور گا
pronunciation.hindi: आघा को दो लयों में उच्चारित किया जाता है - आ और गा
pronunciation.pashto: اګه په د پښتو کې دوه لوړې لېدلي اړه لري

data.cultural_impact: The name "Aaghaa" holds a strong cultural significance as it is associated with the qualities of being a noble man, a leader, and a commander in various Islamic societies. Historically, the title "Aaghaa" was used to denote military commanders and leaders, especially in the Mughal and Persian Empires. The name carries a sense of respect, power, and authority, making it an ideal choice for naming a future leader or a champion.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Aaghaa" holds reference to various positive traits such as nobility, strength, courage, and leadership. Spiritually, one can strive to emulate the qualities of a noble commander or leader in their daily life, seeking to lead others towards righteousness and godliness. The name can also serve as a reminder of the significance of leadership in spiritual growth and community building, highlighting the importance of junior and senior spiritual figures in guiding individuals towards a closer connection with Allah SWT.
